Brandon McDaniel <Brandon.McDaniel@parkview.com>:
Hello Amin or Omid, We got on our study (ID 3867) this morning to check Avicenna data quality and all of the participants show Last Recorded Data Time of Dec 31, 1969 19:00! What is happening? This is an ongoing study, so this has us very worried that something has happened to all of our study data. Did our data get deleted? Is there a way to recover the data? We also have participants in the middle of the study, so if there is something going on this then this would be destroying our study integrity and data collection at the moment. What about all our participants who are currently enrolled in the study and we were collecting data on them? Thank you for your assistance. Brandon T. McDaniel, PhD Parkview Health | Senior Research Scientist Health Services & Informatics Research Mirro Center for Research & Innovation 10622 Parkview Plaza Drive, Fort Wayne, IN 46845 Office Phone: 260.266.7247 Website: Parkview Research------
